title: Boundary-Driven Nonequilibrium for the Coulomb Landau Equation
summary: We establish a nonlinear theory of the Coulomb Landau equation in smooth bounded domains with non-isothermal diffuse reflection. We construct a stationary state, prove its perturbative uniqueness and global nonlinear stability, and establish exponential convergence when the wall temperature approaches its stationary profile exponentially. We also establish stationary and global nonlinear well-posedness for prescribed inflow, together with asymptotic stability.
